title: gauravkp/brbseq pipeline parameters
description: BRB-seq (Bulk RNA Barcoding and sequencing) analysis pipeline: STARsolo-based demultiplexing, alignment and gene x sample quantification

input_output_options.title: Input/output options
input_output_options.description: Define where the pipeline should find input data and save output data.

input.description: Samplesheet listing one pooled sequencing run per row (run, fastq_1, fastq_2, barcode_map). Each run is a multiplexed BRB-seq library containing several barcoded biological samples.
input.help_text: BRB-seq pools many samples into one sequencing run using in-read sample barcodes + UMIs, unlike standard RNA-seq where each row would be one biological sample. Demultiplexing happens downstream via each run's barcode_map, and sample names must be unique across the whole samplesheet.

genome_fasta.description: Path to the reference genome FASTA file. Required unless --star_index is supplied.

gtf.description: Path to the reference annotation GTF file.

star_index.description: Path to a pre-built STAR genome index directory. If provided, genome indexing is skipped.

outdir.description: The output directory where the results will be saved.

multiqc_title.description: MultiQC report title. Printed as page header, used for filename if not otherwise specified.

barcode_umi_options.title: BRB-seq construct geometry (Read1 = barcode + UMI)
barcode_umi_options.description: Describes where the sample barcode and UMI sit within Read1. Defaults match the published BRB-seq example construct, but oligo designs differ between protocol versions and labs - verify against your own construct before trusting results.

solo_cb_start.description: 1-based start position of the sample barcode within Read1.

solo_umi_start.description: 1-based start position of the UMI within Read1, immediately after the barcode.

solo_umi_len.description: Length (bp) of the UMI. Set to 0 if your library has no UMI.

solo_cb_match_wl_type.description: STARsolo barcode-to-whitelist matching stringency (passed through to --soloCBmatchWLtype).

extract_read_counts.description: Also produce a raw (non-UMI-deduplicated) read-count matrix via BRB-seqTools' ExtractReadCountMatrix, alongside STARsolo's own UMI-deduplicated matrix. Off by default; treat as experimental (BRB-seqTools is marked deprecated upstream and its jar is fetched at runtime).

brbseqtools_jar_url.description: URL (or local path) of the BRB-seqTools jar, staged by Nextflow itself. Only used when --extract_read_counts is true.

min_barcode_reads.description: Drop samples whose total count is below this threshold before merging across runs. 0 = no filtering.

differential_expression_options.title: Downstream analysis: differential expression (DESeq2)
differential_expression_options.description: Off unless both --sample_meta and --contrasts are provided. See docs/usage.md and assets/sample_meta_example.csv / assets/contrasts_example.csv for file formats.

sample_meta.description: CSV/TSV with a 'sample' column (matching column names in the merged count matrix) plus one column per covariate used in --contrasts.

contrasts.description: CSV/TSV: id,variable,reference,target - one row per DESeq2 comparison to run. variable must be a column in --sample_meta; reference/target must be two of its values.

deseq2_alpha.description: padj threshold for the 'significant' flag and volcano-plot highlighting.

deseq2_min_count.description: Drop genes with fewer than this many total counts across all samples before fitting.

enrichment_options.title: Downstream analysis: gene-set enrichment (ORA + GSEA)
enrichment_options.description: Off unless --gmt_file is set (also requires --sample_meta/--contrasts, since it runs per DESeq2 contrast). Organism-agnostic: works for any species as long as the GMT's gene IDs match your GTF's gene_id namespace.

gmt_file.description: Gene sets in GMT format: <set_name><TAB><description><TAB><gene1><TAB><gene2>... (e.g. exported from MSigDB).

enrichment_alpha.description: padj threshold defining 'significant' for over-representation analysis (ORA).

enrichment_rank_metric.description: DESeq2 results column used to rank genes for GSEA.

enrichment_min_set_size.description: Drop gene sets smaller than this after restricting to the tested gene universe.

enrichment_max_set_size.description: Drop gene sets larger than this.

enrichment_nperm.description: Permutations used to build the GSEA null distribution.

enrichment_top_n.description: Number of top gene sets shown in each ORA/GSEA plot.

generic_options.title: Generic options
generic_options.description: Less common options, typically set in a config file.

conda_env.description: Path or name of an existing conda environment to use for every process (conda profile only).

validate_params.description: Boolean whether to validate parameters against the schema at runtime.
